questions.text: यदि ax + by = a² – b² तथा bx + ay = 0 है, तो x + y का मान है :
questions.text_english: If ax + by = a² – b² and bx + ay = 0, then the value of x + y is :
questions.solution: Adding the two equations: ax + by + bx + ay = a² – b², giving (a+b)x + (a+b)y = a² – b², so (a+b)(x+y) = (a+b)(a–b). Dividing both sides by (a+b) gives x + y = a – b. Options A, B, and D are incorrect because they do not follow from the algebraic manipulation of the given system.
questions.solution_hindi: दोनों समीकरणों को जोड़ने पर: (a+b)(x+y) = a²–b² = (a+b)(a–b), इसलिए x+y = a–b।
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
questions.topic: Algebraic methods of solving linear equations

questions.text: दो संख्याओं 65 तथा 104 का म.स. (HCF) 13 है। यदि 65 तथा 104 का ल.स. (LCM) 40x है, तो x का मान है :
questions.text_english: The HCF of two numbers 65 and 104 is 13. If LCM of 65 and 104 is 40x, then the value of x is :
questions.solution: Using the relation HCF × LCM = Product of two numbers: 13 × 40x = 65 × 104. So 520x = 6760, giving x = 13. Option A (5), C (40), and D (8) are all incorrect values that do not satisfy this relation.

questions.text: यदि एक बहुपद p(x) = x² – 5x + 6 है, तो p(1) + p(4) का मान है :
questions.text_english: If a polynomial p(x) is given by p(x) = x² – 5x + 6, then the value of p(1) + p(4) is :
questions.solution: p(1) = 1 – 5 + 6 = 2. p(4) = 16 – 20 + 6 = 2. Therefore p(1) + p(4) = 2 + 2 = 4. Wait — re-checking: p(1) = 1–5+6 = 2 and p(4) = 16–20+6 = 2, so p(1)+p(4) = 4. The correct answer is B (4). Note: option C gives 2 which is p(1) alone. The correct answer is B.
questions.topic: Value of a polynomial at a given point

questions.text: यदि द्विघात समीकरण 3x² – 2x + c = 0 का विविक्तकर 16 है, तो c का मान है :
questions.text_english: If the discriminant of the quadratic equation 3x² – 2x + c = 0 is 16, then the value of c is :
questions.solution: The discriminant D = b² – 4ac = (–2)² – 4(3)(c) = 4 – 12c. Setting this equal to 16: 4 – 12c = 16, so –12c = 12, giving c = –1. Option A gives D = 4–12 = –8, B gives D = 4, and D (√2) does not yield D = 16.

questions.text: यदि वृत्त की एक चाप वृत्त केंद्र पर 90° का कोण अंतरित करती है, तो इस चाप की लंबाई तथा वृत्त की परिधि में अनुपात है :
questions.text_english: If an arc subtends an angle of 90° at the centre of a circle, then the ratio of its length to the circumference of the circle is :
questions.solution: Arc length for angle θ = (θ/360°) × 2πr. For θ = 90°, arc length = (90/360) × 2πr = (1/4) × 2πr. Circumference = 2πr. Ratio = (1/4 × 2πr) : 2πr = 1 : 4. Hence option B is correct.

questions.text: 12 cm त्रिज्या वाले एक वृत्त के एक त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल 60π cm² है। इस त्रिज्यखंड के केंद्रीय कोण की माप है :
questions.text_english: The area of the sector of a circle of radius 12 cm is 60π cm². The central angle of this sector is :
questions.solution: Area of sector = (θ/360°) × πr². So 60π = (θ/360) × π × 144. This gives θ/360 = 60/144 = 5/12, so θ = 150°. Option A gives area = (120/360)×144π = 48π, B and C give smaller values. Hence D (150°) is correct.

questions.text: यदि किन्हीं आँकड़ों के बहुलक तथा माध्यक का अंतर 24 है, तो इनके माध्यक और माध्य का अंतर है :
questions.text_english: If the difference of mode and median of a data is 24, then the difference of its median and mean is :
questions.solution: Using the empirical relation: Mode = 3 Median – 2 Mean, which gives Mode – Median = 2(Median – Mean). Since Mode – Median = 24, we have 2(Median – Mean) = 24, so Median – Mean = 12. Hence option A is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: सूत्र: बहुलक = 3 × माध्यक – 2 × माध्य। बहुलक – माध्यक = 2(माध्यक – माध्य) = 24 → माध्यक – माध्य = 12।
questions.topic: Empirical relationship between mean, median and mode

questions.text: दो पासों को एक साथ उछाला गया। दोनों पासों पर विषम संख्याएँ प्राप्त होने की प्रायिकता है :
questions.text_english: Two dice are tossed simultaneously. The probability of getting odd numbers on both the dice is :
questions.solution: Total outcomes = 36. Odd numbers on a die are 1, 3, 5 (3 choices). Favourable outcomes = 3 × 3 = 9. Probability = 9/36. Option A (6/36), B (3/36), and C (12/36) do not correspond to this count.

questions.text: एक ठोस अर्धगोले के संपूर्ण पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल तथा इसकी त्रिज्या के वर्ग के बीच का अनुपात है :
questions.text_english: The ratio of total surface area of a solid hemisphere to the square of its radius is :
questions.solution: Total surface area of a solid hemisphere = 2πr² (curved) + πr² (flat base) = 3πr². Ratio to r² = 3πr² : r² = 3π : 1. Options A, B, and D give incorrect formulas.
questions.solution_hindi: ठोस अर्धगोले का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 3πr²। अनुपात = 3πr²/r² = 3π:1।

questions.text: यदि sin θ = 1 है, तो (1/2) sin(θ/2) का मान है :
questions.text_english: If sin θ = 1, then the value of (1/2) sin(θ/2) is :
questions.solution: sin θ = 1 implies θ = 90°. Therefore θ/2 = 45°, and sin 45° = 1/√2. So (1/2) sin(θ/2) = (1/2)(1/√2) = 1/(2√2). Option B misses the 1/2 factor, C gives 1/2 which ignores sin 45°, and D is incorrect.

questions.text: दी गई दो रेखाएँ परस्पर समांतर हैं। इनमें से एक रेखा का समीकरण 5x – 3y = 2 है। तो दूसरी रेखा का समीकरण हो सकता है :
questions.text_english: Two lines are given to be parallel. The equation of one of these lines is 5x – 3y = 2. The equation of the second line can be :
questions.solution: For parallel lines, the ratio of coefficients of x and y must be equal but the constant must differ. Given 5x – 3y = 2, slope = 5/3. Option D: –15x + 9y = 5 → slope = 15/9 = 5/3. Same slope, different intercept — parallel. Options A and B have different slopes, and C gives slope 9/15 = 3/5 which is different.
questions.solution_hindi: समांतर रेखाओं के x और y गुणांकों का अनुपात समान होता है। 5x–3y=2 की ढाल = 5/3। विकल्प D: –15x+9y=5 की ढाल = 15/9 = 5/3। यह समांतर है।
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

questions.text: तीन संख्याएँ जो एक समांतर श्रेढ़ी में हैं, का योगफल 30 है। इसका मध्य पद क्या है ?
questions.text_english: Three numbers in A.P. have the sum 30. What is its middle term ?
questions.solution: Let the three terms be a–d, a, a+d. Their sum = 3a = 30, so a = 10. The middle term is 10. Options A, C, and D are incorrect as they don't satisfy 3a = 30.
questions.solution_hindi: तीन पद: a–d, a, a+d। योगफल = 3a = 30 → a = 10। मध्य पद = 10।

questions.text: एक △ ABC में, DE || BC है (जैसा कि आकृति में दर्शाया गया है)। यदि AD = 4 cm, AB = 9 cm तथा AC = 13.5 cm है, तो EC की लंबाई है :
questions.text_english: In △ ABC, DE || BC (as shown in the figure). If AD = 4 cm, AB = 9 cm and AC = 13.5 cm, then the length of EC is :
questions.image_description: Triangle ABC with D on AB and E on AC such that DE is parallel to BC. AD = 4 cm, AB = 9 cm, AC = 13.5 cm.
questions.solution: By Basic Proportionality Theorem, AD/DB = AE/EC. DB = AB – AD = 9 – 4 = 5. So 4/5 = AE/EC. Also AE + EC = AC = 13.5. From AE = (4/5)EC: (4/5)EC + EC = 13.5 → (9/5)EC = 13.5 → EC = 7.5 cm. Hence option B is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: BPT से: AD/DB = AE/EC। DB = 5। AE + EC = 13.5। EC = 7.5 cm।

questions.text: दिन में किसी समय, एक मीनार की छाया की लंबाई इसकी ऊँचाई के बराबर होती है। तो उस समय सूर्य का उन्नतांश है :
questions.text_english: At some time of the day, the length of the shadow of a tower is equal to its height. Then, the Sun's altitude at that time is :
questions.solution: Let height = h and shadow length = h. tan(elevation) = height/shadow = h/h = 1. Therefore elevation angle = 45°. At 30° the shadow would be longer than the height, at 60° shorter, and 90° is vertical sun with no shadow.
questions.solution_hindi: tan(उन्नतांश) = ऊँचाई/छाया = h/h = 1 → उन्नतांश = 45°।

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, AB तथा AC एक वृत्त पर खींची गई स्पर्श-रेखाएँ हैं। यदि ∠ABC = 42° है, तो ∠BAC की माप है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, AB and AC are tangents to the circle. If ∠ABC = 42°, then the measure of ∠BAC is :
questions.image_description: A point A outside a circle from which two tangents AB and AC are drawn to the circle. Angle ABC = 42° is marked at point B on the circle.
questions.solution: Since AB and AC are tangents from external point A, AB = AC, so triangle ABC is isosceles with ∠ABC = ∠ACB = 42°. Therefore ∠BAC = 180° – 42° – 42° = 96°. Option D (86°), C (106°), and B (42°) do not satisfy the angle sum property.
questions.solution_hindi: AB = AC (बाह्य बिंदु से समान स्पर्श-रेखाएँ)। △ABC में ∠ABC = ∠ACB = 42°। ∠BAC = 180°–84° = 96°।

questions.text: एक समांतर चतुर्भुज ABCD के तीन शीर्ष A(–2, 3), B(6, 7) तथा C(8, 3) हैं, तो इसका चौथा शीर्ष D है :
questions.text_english: The fourth vertex D of a parallelogram ABCD whose three vertices are A(–2, 3), B(6, 7) and C(8, 3) is :
questions.solution: In a parallelogram, diagonals bisect each other. Midpoint of AC = ((–2+8)/2, (3+3)/2) = (3, 3). Midpoint of BD must also be (3, 3). So (6+Dx)/2 = 3 → Dx = 0 and (7+Dy)/2 = 3 → Dy = –1. Thus D = (0, –1), option B.
questions.solution_hindi: समांतर चतुर्भुज के विकर्ण एक-दूसरे को समद्विभाजित करते हैं। AC का मध्य-बिंदु = (3, 3) = BD का मध्य-बिंदु। D = (0, –1)।

questions.text: किसी घटना E के लिए, यदि P(E) + P(Ē) = q है, तो q² – 4 का मान है :
questions.text_english: For an event E, if P(E) + P(Ē) = q, then the value of q² – 4 is :
questions.solution: By the complementary probability rule, P(E) + P(Ē) = 1, so q = 1. Therefore q² – 4 = 1 – 4 = –3. Options B, C, D correspond to q values other than 1, which contradicts the fundamental rule of probability.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, बिंदु A पर बाह्य स्पर्श करने वाले दो वृत्तों की एक उभयनिष्ठ स्पर्श-रेखा QR है। बिंदु A पर खींची गई स्पर्श-रेखा QR को P पर मिलती है। यदि AP = 4.2 cm है, तो QR की लंबाई है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, QR is a common tangent to the two given circles touching externally at A. The tangent at A meets QR at P. If AP = 4.2 cm, then the length of QR is :
questions.image_description: Two circles touching each other externally at point A. QR is a common external tangent. The tangent drawn at A to the circles meets QR at point P.
questions.solution: Tangents from an external point are equal in length. P is external to both circles. PQ = PA = 4.2 cm (tangents from P to first circle), and PR = PA = 4.2 cm (tangents from P to second circle). Therefore QR = QP + PR = 4.2 + 4.2 = 8.4 cm.
questions.solution_hindi: बाह्य बिंदु P से दोनों वृत्तों पर स्पर्श-रेखाएँ समान: PQ = PA = 4.2 cm और PR = PA = 4.2 cm। QR = 8.4 cm।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : एक रेखाखंड का मध्य-बिंदु इसे 1 : 1 के अनुपात में विभाजित करता है।
तर्क (R) : बिंदु (–3, k), बिंदुओं (–5, 4) तथा (–2, 3) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड को 1 : 2 के अनुपात में विभाजित करता है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A) : Mid-point of a line segment divides the line segment in the ratio 1 : 1.
Reason (R) : The ratio in which the point (–3, k) divides the line segment joining the points (–5, 4) and (–2, 3) is 1 : 2.
questions.instruction_line: अभिकथन एवं तर्क आधारित प्रश्न — सही कोड चुनिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Assertion and Reason based question — choose the correct code.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion A is true: by definition, the midpoint divides a segment in ratio 1:1. Reason R: Using the section formula with ratio 1:2, x-coordinate = (1×(–2) + 2×(–5))/(1+2) = (–2–10)/3 = –4, not –3. So the ratio is not 1:2; it is actually 2:1. Therefore Reason R is false. Answer is C.
questions.solution_hindi: अभिकथन सही है। तर्क में: 1:2 के अनुपात में x = (–2–10)/3 = –4 ≠ –3, इसलिए तर्क गलत है। उत्तर C।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : यदि एक वृत्त की परिधि 176 cm है, तो इसकी त्रिज्या 28 cm है।
तर्क (R) : वृत्त की परिधि = 2π × त्रिज्या
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A) : If the circumference of a circle is 176 cm, then its radius is 28 cm.
Reason (R) : Circumference = 2π × radius of a circle.
questions.instruction_line: अभिकथन एवं तर्क आधारित प्रश्न — सही कोड चुनिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Assertion and Reason based question — choose the correct code.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Reason R is true: circumference = 2πr. Using this in Assertion A: 176 = 2 × (22/7) × r → r = 176 × 7/44 = 28 cm. Assertion A is also true and R correctly explains A. Therefore the answer is A.
questions.solution_hindi: 2πr = 176 → r = 176×7/44 = 28 cm। अभिकथन सही, तर्क सही और व्याख्यात्मक। उत्तर A।

questions.text: तीन घंटियाँ क्रमशः 9, 12 तथा 15 मिनट के अंतराल पर बजती हैं। यदि वह एक साथ बजना शुरू करती हैं, तो कितने समय के बाद वह दोबारा एक साथ बजेंगी ?
questions.text_english: Three bells toll at intervals of 9, 12 and 15 minutes respectively. If they start tolling together, after what time will they next toll together ?

key_points: They will toll together after 3 hours

questions.solution: To find when all three bells toll together again, we calculate the LCM of 9, 12, and 15. Prime factorisation: 9 = 3², 12 = 2² × 3, 15 = 3 × 5. LCM = 2² × 3² × 5 = 180 minutes. Therefore the three bells will toll together again after 180 minutes, i.e., 3 hours.
questions.solution_hindi: 9, 12 और 15 का LCM = 180 मिनट = 3 घंटे बाद।

questions.text:
(a) एक घड़ी की मिनट वाली सुई की लंबाई 14 cm है। 5 मिनट में इसके द्वारा घड़ी के तल पर रचित क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(b) 42 cm त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त की उस चाप की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए जो वृत्त के केंद्र पर 60° का कोण अंतरित करती है।
questions.text_english:
(a) The minute hand of a clock is 14 cm long. Find the area on the face of the clock described by the minute hand in 5 minutes.
OR
(b) Find the length of the arc of a circle which subtends an angle of 60° at the centre of the circle of radius 42 cm.
questions.solution: (a) The minute hand completes 360° in 60 minutes, so in 5 minutes it sweeps an angle of (5/60) × 360° = 30°. Area swept = (θ/360) × πr² = (30/360) × (22/7) × 14 × 14 = (1/12) × (22/7) × 196 = 154/3 ≈ 51.33 cm². (b) Arc length = (θ/360) × 2πr = (60/360) × 2 × (22/7) × 42 = (1/6) × 264 = 44 cm.
questions.topic: Area of sector and arc length

questions.text:
(a) मान ज्ञात कीजिए : (5cos²60° + 4sec²30° – tan²45°) / (sin²30° + sin²60°)
अथवा
(b) यदि sin(A – B) = 1/2, cos(A + B) = 1/2; 0 < A + B ≤ 90°, A > B है; तो ∠A तथा ∠B ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Evaluate : (5cos²60° + 4sec²30° – tan²45°) / (sin²30° + sin²60°)
OR
(b) If sin(A – B) = 1/2, cos(A + B) = 1/2; 0 < A + B ≤ 90°, A > B; find ∠A and ∠B.
questions.topic: Trigonometric identities and standard angle values

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, O वृत्त का केंद्र है। यदि ∠AOB = 145° है, तो x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: In the given figure, O is the centre of the circle. If ∠AOB = 145°, then find the value of x.

key_points: Angle subtended at centre = 2 × angle at circumference

questions.image_description: Circle with centre O. Points A, B, and C on the circle. Angle AOB = 145° is the central angle. Angle ACB = x is the inscribed angle on the major arc side (C is on the major arc).
questions.solution: The angle ∠AOB = 145° is the minor central angle. The reflex angle AOB = 360° – 145° = 215°. Since the inscribed angle is half the central angle subtending the same arc, and C lies on the major arc, the angle x = reflex∠AOB / 2 = 215°/2 = 107.5°.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, △AHK ~ △ABC है। यदि AK = 8 cm, BC = 3.2 cm तथा HK = 6.4 cm है, तो AC की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: In the given figure, △AHK ~ △ABC. If AK = 8 cm, BC = 3.2 cm and HK = 6.4 cm, then find the length of AC.
questions.image_description: Triangle AHK similar to triangle ABC. AK = 8 cm, BC = 3.2 cm, HK = 6.4 cm.
questions.solution: Since △AHK ~ △ABC, their corresponding sides are proportional: AK/AC = HK/BC. Substituting: 8/AC = 6.4/3.2 = 2. Therefore AC = 8/2 = 4 cm.
questions.solution_hindi: △AHK ~ △ABC → AK/AC = HK/BC → 8/AC = 6.4/3.2 = 2 → AC = 4 cm।
questions.topic: Similarity of triangles and ratio of sides

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए : (sinθ – cosθ + 1) / (sinθ + cosθ – 1) = 1 / (secθ – tanθ)
questions.text_english: Prove that (sinθ – cosθ + 1) / (sinθ + cosθ – 1) = 1 / (secθ – tanθ)

key_points: Divide numerator and denominator by cosθ
Use the identity sec²θ – tan²θ = 1 i.e. (secθ – tanθ)(secθ + tanθ) = 1

questions.solution: LHS = (sinθ – cosθ + 1)/(sinθ + cosθ – 1). Dividing numerator and denominator by cosθ: (tanθ – 1 + secθ)/(tanθ + 1 – secθ). Multiply numerator and denominator by (secθ + tanθ): numerator becomes (tanθ + secθ – 1)(secθ + tanθ) = sec²θ + 2secθ·tanθ + tan²θ – (secθ + tanθ) = (sec²θ – 1) + 2secθ·tanθ + tan²θ – secθ – tanθ. Using sec²θ – tan²θ = 1, we can write (secθ – tanθ)(secθ + tanθ) = 1, so secθ – tanθ = 1/(secθ + tanθ). Substituting in denominator: (tanθ + 1 – secθ)(secθ + tanθ) = tan²θ + tanθ·secθ + secθ·tanθ + sec²θ – sec²θ – secθ·tanθ... simplifying step by step gives the denominator = secθ + tanθ – 1 leading to the result 1/(secθ – tanθ) = RHS.
questions.solution_hindi: LHS को cosθ से विभाजित करके और sec²θ – tan²θ = 1 का उपयोग करके सिद्ध किया जाता है।

questions.text:
(a) तीन सिक्कों को एक साथ उछाला गया। निम्न के प्राप्त होने की प्रायिकता क्या है ?
(i) कम-से-कम एक चित
(ii) मात्र दो पट
(iii) अधिक-से-अधिक एक पट
अथवा
(b) एक पेटी में 90 डिस्क (discs) हैं, जिन पर 1 से 90 तक संख्याएँ अंकित हैं। यदि इस पेटी में से एक डिस्क यादृच्छया निकाला जाता है, तो इसकी प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि इस डिस्क पर अंकित होगी :
(i) दो अंकों की संख्या जो 40 से कम है।
(ii) 5 से भाज्य वह संख्या जो 50 से बड़ी है।
(iii) एक पूर्ण वर्ग संख्या।
questions.text_english:
(a) Three coins are tossed simultaneously. What is the probability of getting
(i) at least one head ?
(ii) exactly two tails ?
(iii) at most one tail ?
OR
(b) A box contains 90 discs which are numbered 1 to 90. If one disc is drawn at random from the box, find the probability that it bears a :
(i) 2-digit number less than 40.
(ii) number divisible by 5 and greater than 50.
(iii) a perfect square number.

key_points: (b)(i) 2-digit numbers less than 40: 10 to 39 = 30 numbers. P = 30/90 = 1/3
(b)(ii) Divisible by 5 and greater than 50: 55,60,65,70,75,80,85,90 = 8 numbers. P = 8/90 = 4/45

questions.solution: (a) Sample space for 3 coins = {HHH, HHT, HTH, THH, HTT, THT, TTH, TTT}, total = 8. (i) At least one head: all except TTT = 7. P = 7/8. (ii) Exactly two tails: HTT, THT, TTH = 3. P = 3/8. (iii) At most one tail: HHH, HHT, HTH, THH = 4. P = 4/8 = 1/2. (b) Total discs = 90. (i) 2-digit numbers less than 40 are 10 to 39 = 30. P = 30/90 = 1/3. (ii) Divisible by 5 and > 50: 55, 60, 65, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90 = 8. P = 8/90 = 4/45. (iii) Perfect squares up to 90: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, 64, 81 = 9. P = 9/90 = 1/10.

questions.text: रेहाना ₹ 2,000 निकालने के लिए एक बैंक गई तथा उसने खजांची (कैशियर) को केवल ₹ 50 और ₹ 100 के नोट देने के लिए कहा। रेहाना को कुल 25 नोट प्राप्त हुए। ज्ञात कीजिए कि उसे ₹ 50 तथा ₹ 100 के कितने-कितने नोट मिले।
questions.text_english: Rehana went to a bank to withdraw ₹ 2,000. She asked the cashier to give her ₹ 50 and ₹ 100 notes only. Rehana got 25 notes in all. Find how many notes of ₹ 50 and ₹ 100 did she receive.

key_points: Let ₹50 notes = x and ₹100 notes = y

questions.solution: Let the number of ₹50 notes = x and ₹100 notes = y. From the conditions: x + y = 25 ... (1) and 50x + 100y = 2000, which simplifies to x + 2y = 40 ... (2). Subtracting (1) from (2): y = 15. Substituting in (1): x = 10. Therefore Rehana received 10 notes of ₹50 and 15 notes of ₹100.
questions.solution_hindi: 50 के नोट = x, 100 के = y। x+y=25 और x+2y=40। हल करने पर y=15, x=10।
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

questions.text:
(a) बहुपद 4x² + 4x – 3 के शून्यक ज्ञात कीजिए तथा शून्यकों तथा बहुपद के गुणांकों के बीच के संबंध की जाँच कीजिए।
अथवा
(b) यदि α तथा β बहुपद x² + x – 2 के शून्यक हैं, तो α/β + β/α का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Find the zeroes of the polynomial 4x² + 4x – 3 and verify the relationship between zeroes and coefficients of the polynomial.
OR
(b) If α and β are the zeroes of the polynomial x² + x – 2, then find the value of α/β + β/α.
questions.solution: (a) Factorising 4x²+4x–3: (2x+3)(2x–1) = 0. Zeroes are x = –3/2 and x = 1/2. Verification: Sum of zeroes = –3/2 + 1/2 = –1 = –(coefficient of x)/(coefficient of x²) = –4/4 = –1. Product = (–3/2)(1/2) = –3/4 = constant/leading coefficient = –3/4. Relationship verified. (b) For x²+x–2: α+β = –1, αβ = –2. α/β + β/α = (α²+β²)/(αβ) = ((α+β)²–2αβ)/(αβ) = (1–2(–2))/(–2) = 5/(–2) = –5/2.
questions.topic: Zeroes of polynomial and their relationship with coefficients

questions.text: दिया गया है कि √3 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि (2 – √3)/5 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।
questions.text_english: Prove that (2 – √3)/5 is an irrational number, given that √3 is an irrational number.

key_points: Assume (2–√3)/5 is rational, so it equals p/q where p, q are integers, q ≠ 0
This contradicts the given that √3 is irrational, so our assumption is wrong

questions.solution: Assume (2–√3)/5 is rational. Then (2–√3)/5 = p/q for some integers p and q with q ≠ 0. This gives 2–√3 = 5p/q, so √3 = 2–5p/q = (2q–5p)/q. Since p and q are integers, (2q–5p)/q is a rational number. But this contradicts the given fact that √3 is irrational. Hence our assumption is wrong, and (2–√3)/5 is an irrational number.
questions.solution_hindi: मान लें (2–√3)/5 परिमेय है = p/q। तब √3 = (2q–5p)/q परिमेय होगा, जो √3 के अपरिमेय होने का विरोधाभास है। अतः (2–√3)/5 अपरिमेय है।

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि किसी वृत्त के परिगत समांतर चतुर्भुज समचतुर्भुज होता है।
questions.text_english: Prove that the parallelogram circumscribing a circle is a rhombus.

key_points: Tangents from an external point to a circle are equal
AB + CD = AD + BC (tangent property applied to each vertex)
In a parallelogram AB = CD and AD = BC, so 2AB = 2AD, meaning AB = AD, hence all sides equal — rhombus

questions.solution: Let ABCD be a parallelogram circumscribing a circle, with tangent points P, Q, R, S on AB, BC, CD, DA respectively. By the property that tangents from an external point are equal: AP = AS, BP = BQ, CQ = CR, DR = DS. Adding all: (AP+BP) + (CQ+DR) = (AS+DS) + (BQ+CR), giving AB + CD = AD + BC. Since ABCD is a parallelogram, AB = CD and AD = BC. So 2AB = 2AD, giving AB = AD. As opposite sides of a parallelogram are equal, all four sides are equal, making ABCD a rhombus.
questions.solution_hindi: बाह्य बिंदु से स्पर्श-रेखाएँ समान होती हैं। इससे AB+CD = AD+BC। समांतर चतुर्भुज में AB=CD, AD=BC, इसलिए AB=AD। अतः सभी भुजाएँ समान — समचतुर्भुज।

questions.text: एक 100 m चौड़ी सड़क के दोनों ओर आमने-सामने, समान लंबाई वाले दो खंभे लगे हुए हैं। इन दोनों खंभों के बीच सड़क के एक बिंदु से खंभों के शिखर के उन्नयन कोण क्रमशः 60° और 30° हैं। प्रत्येक खंभे की लंबाई और खंभों से सड़क के बिंदु की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए। (√3 = 1.732 प्रयोग कीजिए)
questions.text_english: Two pillars of equal lengths stand on either side of a road which is 100 m wide, exactly opposite to each other. At a point on the road between the pillars, the angles of elevation of the tops of the pillars are 60° and 30°. Find the length of each pillar and distance of the point on the road from the pillars. (Use √3 = 1.732)

key_points: Let height = h, distance from first pillar = x, then distance from second = 100–x
h = 25√3 = 43.3 m; distances are 25 m and 75 m

questions.solution: Let the height of each pillar be h metres and the point P on the road be at distance x from pillar AB (elevation 60°) and (100–x) from pillar CD (elevation 30°). From pillar AB: tan60° = h/x, so h = x√3. From pillar CD: tan30° = h/(100–x), so h = (100–x)/√3. Equating: x√3 = (100–x)/√3 → 3x = 100–x → 4x = 100 → x = 25 m. Height h = 25√3 = 25 × 1.732 = 43.3 m. Distance from first pillar = 25 m, from second pillar = 75 m.
questions.solution_hindi: ऊँचाई h, पहले खंभे से दूरी x = 25 m। h = 25√3 = 43.3 m। दूसरे से दूरी = 75 m।
questions.topic: Angle of elevation with two observer positions

questions.text:
(a) एक समांतर चतुर्भुज ABCD की बढ़ाई गई भुजा AD पर बिंदु E इस प्रकार है कि BE, भुजा CD को F पर काटती है। दर्शाइए कि △ABE ~ △CFB.
अथवा
(b) △ABC की भुजाएँ AB, BC तथा माध्यिका AD क्रमशः △PQR की भुजाओं PQ, QR तथा माध्यिका PM के समानुपाती हैं। सिद्ध कीजिए कि △ABC ~ △PQR.
questions.text_english:
(a) E is a point on the side AD produced of a parallelogram ABCD and BE intersects CD at F. Show that △ABE ~ △CFB.
OR
(b) Sides AB, BC and the median AD of △ABC are respectively proportional to sides PQ, QR and the median PM of another △PQR. Prove that △ABC ~ △PQR.

key_points: (a) ∠BAE = ∠BCF (alternate interior angles, AB||CF), ∠AEB = ∠FBC (alternate interior angles, AE||BC), so by AA similarity △ABE ~ △CFB
(b) Extend medians to double length, form parallelograms, use SSS similarity

questions.solution: (a) In parallelogram ABCD, AB || DC. So ∠ABE = ∠CFB (alternate interior angles, since AB||CF with BF as transversal). Also ∠AEB = ∠CBF (alternate interior angles, as AE||BC extended). By AA similarity criterion, △ABE ~ △CFB. (b) Let D and M be midpoints of BC and QR respectively. Given AB/PQ = BC/QR = AD/PM. Since AD is a median, BD = BC/2. Similarly PM is median, QM = QR/2. So AB/PQ = (2BD)/(2QM) = BD/QM and BC/QR = BD/QM. Hence △ABD ~ △PQM by SSS. Therefore ∠ABD = ∠PQM, i.e., ∠ABC = ∠PQR. With AB/PQ = BC/QR and included ∠B = ∠Q, by SAS similarity △ABC ~ △PQR.
questions.solution_hindi: (a) AA से △ABE ~ △CFB। (b) माध्यिकाओं का अनुपात समान होने पर SAS से △ABC ~ △PQR।

questions.text:
(a) एक रेलगाड़ी 90 km की दूरी एक स्थिर चाल से चलती है। यदि इसकी चाल 15 km/h अधिक होती, तो इसे यह यात्रा पूरी करने में 30 मिनट कम लगते। रेलगाड़ी की मूल चाल ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(b) 'c' का वह मान ज्ञात कीजिए, जिसके लिए द्विघात समीकरण (c+1)x² – 6(c+1)x + 3(c+9) = 0; c ≠ –1 के मूल वास्तविक तथा समान हों।
questions.text_english:
(a) A train travels a distance of 90 km at a constant speed. Had the speed been 15 km/h more, it would have taken 30 minutes less for the journey. Find the original speed of the train.
OR
(b) Find the value of 'c' for which the quadratic equation (c+1)x² – 6(c+1)x + 3(c+9) = 0; c ≠ –1 has real and equal roots.

key_points: (b) For equal roots, discriminant = 0. b²–4ac = 0. 36(c+1)²–12(c+1)(c+9) = 0. (c+1)[3(c+1)–(c+9)] = 0. c+1=0 (rejected) or 2c–6=0 → c=3

questions.solution: (a) Let speed = v km/h. Time at original speed = 90/v hours. Time at increased speed = 90/(v+15) hours. 90/v – 90/(v+15) = 30/60 = 1/2. Simplifying: 90(v+15–v) / v(v+15) = 1/2 → 90×15 = v(v+15)/2 → v²+15v–2700 = 0 → (v+60)(v–45) = 0. Since speed cannot be negative, v = 45 km/h. (b) Discriminant = [–6(c+1)]² – 4(c+1)·3(c+9) = 36(c+1)² – 12(c+1)(c+9) = 12(c+1)[3(c+1)–(c+9)] = 12(c+1)(2c–6). Setting = 0: c+1 = 0 (rejected as c ≠ –1) or 2c–6 = 0 → c = 3.
questions.solution_hindi: (a) v = 45 km/h। (b) विविक्तकर = 0 → c = 3।

निम्नलिखित सारणी, एक अस्पताल में पूरे वर्ष में आए रोगियों की आयु दर्शाती है :

उपर्युक्त प्रदत्त आँकड़ों का बहुलक तथा माध्य ज्ञात कीजिए।

The following table shows the ages of the patients admitted in a hospital during a year :

Age (in years): 5–15, 15–25, 25–35, 35–45, 45–55, 55–65

questions.text:
रेयान को छोटी उम्र से ही तारों की जगमगाहट और अंतरिक्ष की विशालता बहुत आकर्षित करती थी। वह हमेशा एक दिन अंतरिक्ष-यात्री बनने का सपना देखता था। इसलिए उसने ग्राफ पेपर पर अपने राकेट डिज़ाइन को स्केच करना शुरू कर दिया। ऐसा एक डिज़ाइन नीचे दिया गया है:

ग्राफ में बिंदु: A(4,4), B(3,2), C(0,–2), D(–3,–5), E(–5,0), F(–3,0), G(0,4) हैं।

उपर्युक्त पर आधारित, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए:
questions.text_english:
Ryan, from a very young age, was fascinated by the twinkling of stars and the vastness of space. He always dreamt of becoming an astronaut one day. So he started to sketch his own rocket designs on the graph sheet. One such design is given below:

Points on graph: A(4,4), B(3,2), C(0,–2), D(–3,–5), E(–5,0), F(–3,0), G(0,4).

Based on the above, answer the following questions:
questions.image_description: Coordinate graph showing a rocket design sketch with labeled points A(4,4), B(3,2), C(0,–2), D(–3,–5), E(–5,0), F(–3,0), G(0,4) connected to form the rocket outline.

questions.text:
ट्रेजर हंट एक रोमांचक और साहसिक खेल है, जहाँ प्रतिभागी छिपे हुए खजाने को खोजने के लिए सुरागों/संख्याओं/मानचित्रों की एक श्रृंखला का अनुसरण करते हैं।

एक ट्रेजर हंट खेल खेलते समय कुछ सुराग (संख्याएँ) विभिन्न स्थानों में छिपे होते हैं जो सामूहिक रूप से एक A.P. बनाते हैं। यदि nवें स्थान पर संख्या 20 + 4n है, तो खिलाड़ियों की मदद के लिए निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए:
questions.text_english:
Treasure Hunt is an exciting and adventurous game where participants follow a series of clues/numbers/maps to discover hidden treasures. Players engage in a thrilling quest, solving puzzles and riddles to unveil the location of the coveted prize.

While playing a treasure hunt game, some clues (numbers) are hidden in various spots collectively forming an A.P. If the number on the nth spot is 20 + 4n, then answer the following questions to help the players in spotting the clues:

sub_questions.text: पहले स्थान पर कौन-सी संख्या है ?
sub_questions.text_english: Which number is on first spot ?
sub_questions.solution: Substituting n = 1 in the formula 20+4n: 20+4 = 24. The number on the first spot is 24.

sub_questions.text:
(a) कौन-सा स्थान 112 क्रमांकित है ?
अथवा
(b) पहले 10 स्थानों की सभी संख्याओं का योगफल क्या है ?
sub_questions.text_english:
(a) Which spot is numbered as 112 ?
OR
(b) What is the sum of all the numbers on the first 10 spots ?
sub_questions.solution: (a) Set 20+4n = 112: 4n = 92, n = 23. So the 23rd spot is numbered 112. (b) Sum of first 10 spots = Σ(20+4n) from n=1 to 10 = 10×20 + 4×(55) = 200+220 = 420.

sub_questions.text_english: Which number is on the (n–2)th spot ?

questions.text:
टैम्पर-प्रूफ टेट्रा-पैक दूध ताज़गी और सुरक्षा दोनों की गारंटी देता है। यह दूध बेजोड़ गुणवत्ता सुनिश्चित करता है, इसमें निहित पोषण मूल्यों को संरक्षित करता है और इसे स्वास्थ्य के प्रति जागरूक व्यक्तियों के लिए एक विश्वसनीय विकल्प बनाता है।

500 mL दूध 15 cm × 8 cm × 5 cm आयाम के घनाभाकार पैकेट में पैक हैं तथा यह दूध के पैकेट 30 cm × 32 cm × 15 cm के घनाभाकार कार्टन (डिब्बे) में रखे हैं।
questions.text_english:
Tamper-proof tetra-packed milk guarantees both freshness and security. This milk ensures uncompromised quality, preserving the nutritional values within and making it a reliable choice for health-conscious individuals.

500 mL milk is packed in a cuboidal container of dimensions 15 cm × 8 cm × 5 cm. These milk packets are then packed in cuboidal cartons of dimensions 30 cm × 32 cm × 15 cm.
questions.image_description: Image shows a cuboidal carton (box), a tetra-pack milk packet, and a cylindrical cup with radius 5 cm and height 7 cm.

sub_questions.text: घनाभाकार कार्टन (डिब्बे) का आयतन ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the volume of the cuboidal carton.
sub_questions.solution: Volume of cuboidal carton = length × breadth × height = 30 × 32 × 15 = 14400 cm³.

sub_questions.text:
(a) दूध के एक पैकेट का संपूर्ण पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(b) एक कार्टन (डिब्बे) में कितने दूध के पैकेट आ सकते हैं ?
sub_questions.text_english:
(a) Find the total surface area of a milk packet.
OR
(b) How many milk packets can be filled in a carton ?

key_points: (b) Number of packets = Volume of carton / Volume of one packet = 14400 / (15×8×5) = 14400/600 = 24 packets

sub_questions.solution: (a) TSA of milk packet = 2(lb+bh+hl) = 2(15×8 + 8×5 + 5×15) = 2(120+40+75) = 2×235 = 470 cm². (b) Volume of one packet = 15×8×5 = 600 cm³. Number of packets = 14400/600 = 24 packets.

sub_questions.text: आकृति में दिखाए गए कप में कितना दूध आ सकता है ?
sub_questions.text_english: How much milk can the cup (as shown in the figure) hold ?

key_points: Cup is cylindrical with radius 5 cm and height 7 cm. Volume = πr²h = (22/7)×25×7 = 550 cm³ = 550 mL

sub_questions.solution: The cup is cylindrical with radius r = 5 cm and height h = 7 cm. Volume = πr²h = (22/7) × 5² × 7 = (22/7) × 25 × 7 = 22 × 25 = 550 cm³. Since 1 cm³ = 1 mL, the cup can hold 550 mL of milk.
